title: Chemogenetic inhibition of ventral hippocampal inputs to the basal amygdala reduces anxiety-like behavior.
summary: Anxiety disorders pose a major global health burden, with an urgent need for improved, circuit-informed treatments. Recent studies have suggested a key role for the ventral hippocampus (vHpc), with diverse outputs from the vHpc implicated in the modulation of anxiety-like behavior. In this study, we focus on vHpc projections to the basal amygdala (BA), a prominent limbic circuit that regulates affect-related behavioral responses. Using a chemogenetic approach with Designer Receptors Exclusively Activated by Designer Drugs (DREADDs), we selectively inhibited CaMKII-expressing neurons in the vHpc CA1 subfield and show that it reduces anxiety-like behavior on the elevated plus maze (EPM). Further, we used dual viral transduction strategy with the Cre-DIO (Double-floxed Inverted Open reading frame) system to specifically target vHpc inputs to the BA, with anterograde Cre expressed in vHpc CamKII neurons and retrograde DIO-hM4Di/hM3Dq expressed in the BA. We find that hM4Di-mediated chemogenetic inhibition of vHpc-BA inputs evokes a decline in anxiety-like behavior on the EPM. However, hM3Dq-mediated chemogenetic activation of the vHpc-BA pathway did not appear to alter anxiety-like measures on the EPM. These findings suggest that circuit-specific inhibition of vHpc to BA afferents is sufficient to evoke a decline in anxiety-like behavior on the EPM, whereas activation of the same pathway does not appear to regulate anxiety-like behavior in adult male Sprague-Dawley rats. Our results underscore the importance of analyzing projection-specific activation and inhibition of specific limbic brain circuits to determine their importance in modulating anxiety-like behavior.

标题：腹侧海马体向基底杏仁核输入的化学遗传抑制减轻焦虑样行为
摘要：焦虑障碍构成了重大的全球健康负担，迫切需要改进的、基于环路认知的治疗方法。近期研究表明，腹侧海马体（vHpc）在焦虑样行为的调节中发挥关键作用，其多种输出通路与此相关。本研究聚焦于vHpc到基底杏仁核（BA）的投射，这是一个关键的边缘系统环路，调节情感相关的行为反应。通过使用设计药物独家激活的设计受体（DREADDs）的化学遗传方法，我们选择性抑制了vHpc CA1亚区中表达CaMKII的神经元，并发现这能减少高架十字迷宫（EPM）中的焦虑样行为。进一步，我们采用Cre-DIO系统的双病毒转导策略，在vHpc CamKII神经元中表达顺行Cre，在BA中表达逆行DIO-hM4Di/hM3Dq，从而特异性靶向vHpc到BA的输入。结果发现，hM4Di介导的vHpc-BA输入化学遗传抑制引起了EPM中焦虑样行为的下降。然而，hM3Dq介导的vHpc-BA通路化学遗传激活并未改变EPM中的焦虑样指标。这些发现表明，特异性抑制vHpc到BA的传入通路足以引起EPM中焦虑样行为的下降，而激活同一通路在成年雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠中似乎不调节焦虑样行为。我们的结果强调了分析特定边缘系统脑环路投射方向激活与抑制在调节焦虑样行为中的重要性。
关键词：焦虑样行为；腹侧海马体；基底杏仁核；化学遗传学；情感调节
